name: Belgian Chocolate & brownie Ice Cream
ingredients_raw: Water, Milk Solid (Cream, Butter, Skimmed Milk Powder), Sugar, Brownie (10 %) (Sugar, Maida, Water, Cocoa Powder (5.5 %),Edible Vegetable oil (Palm, Cotton Seed), Milk Solids, lodized Salt, Raising Agent (INS 500 (ii), Emulsifier & Stabilizer (INS 1412, INS 1440, INS 1442, INS 322, INS 415, INS 471), CONTAINS NATURE IDENTICAL CHOCOLATE AND ARTIFICIAL VANILLA FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES.), Dark Chocolate (9 %) (Sugar, Cocoa Solids, Cocoa Butter & Emulsifier (INS 322) CONTAINS ADDED NATURE IDENTICAL VANILLA FLAVOURING SUBSTANCE), Cocoa Solids, Emulsifier (INS 471, INS 433) and Stabilisers (INS 466, INS 412, INS 407a)
